title: Course-map assessment disappears before export
purpose: Proves assessments must resolve to downstream artifacts or an explicit caveat.

files.Lesson Plans/Lesson 1 - Regulatory Tools: This lesson compares command-and-control regulation, market incentives, and information disclosure. Students map each tool to a pollution problem, discuss administrative feasibility, and complete a quick check explaining which tool best fits a local air-quality scenario.
files.Quiz & Exam Bank/Lesson 3 - Cost Benefit: The quiz asks students to interpret cost-benefit tables, identify distributional limits, and explain why monetized benefits do not settle every public decision. Each item includes a correct answer and short rationale.
